segments.en: At the entrance of the village, the talk of a price does not stand. The reason it does not stand is that they could not put Falco in front of the mother. They could not put him there because Gabi, Reiner, and the friends who came late were there at the same time. The people who were there were enemies until yesterday. While still enemies, they stand on the side that guards the same boy. The standing is the first loosening of the ice. The first loosening does not stop the walls. Without stopping them, it stops only one trade for a mother.

segments.en: On the same day, in another place, a crystal shell loosens slightly. Annie is inside the shell that loosens. The Annie who is there has not fully woken from a long sleep. Without having woken, a thin line enters the surface that was hard. Someone on the ground sees the line that enters, from far away. The detail of seeing is not the center of today. It is not. What it sets down is that one frozen thing has started to make a sound. The sound that started is not yet words.

segments.en: In front of the children, Reiner explains the row of the walls. The content he explains is that Marley's justice can no longer stop it. After it did not, he does not let Falco go deep into the village. The shoulder that does not let him go is a continuation of yesterday's shield.
